G2837.d: κοιμάω, -ῶ ; [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַב ;] ; to lull to sleep, put to sleep. Mid and pass., to fall asleep (M, Pr., 162; M, Th., 1, 4, 13): Mat.28:13, Luk.22:45, Jhn.11:12, Act.12:6.
